info.title: Aditya BioNova Rural Smart HMS API
info.description: Aditya BioNova Rural Smart HMS — multi-tenant clinic & hospital management API. Synthetic/development data only; no real patient data.

post.description:
Onboard a new clinic/organization with its owner account.

Creates organization + owner user + owner membership in one transaction.
The transaction-local ``app.is_bootstrap`` flag is the only path through
the organizations INSERT row-level policy.

Rotate the refresh token. Replaying an already-rotated token revokes
the whole session family (reuse detection) and is audited.

post.description:
Supervised duplicate resolution: source record is retired into target.

Nothing is deleted — the source keeps its UHID, points at the survivor
(``merged_into_id``) and becomes read-only; both sides are audited.
